# @ui-sdk/core docs

The ui-sdk docs for the framework-free core, as Markdown, for the release this package came from. Each framework's package has its own pages, like `@ui-sdk/react/docs`.

[llms.txt](./llms.txt) is the Core docs, the same as core.md, under the name agents look for.

## Core and Agents

- [Core](./core.md): Give your agents the behaviors to build headless and accessible components, with keyboard, focus and screen reader support built in. Every Core page in one file.
- [Agents](./agents.md): ui-sdk gives agents the building blocks to create components and the tools to use them. Every Agents page in one file.

## Skills

- [ui-sdk](../skills/ui-sdk/SKILL.md): builds interfaces with ui-sdk, components it doesn't ship from the behaviors in this package, agent support and tests.
